purpose: Detect cross-ledger contradictions, retained-scope disappearance, orphaned unfinished work, stale receipt/current-state lineage, unproven new supersession and public/equivalence receipt defects without creating a second Steward, roadmap, scope ledger or current-state owner.

authority_boundary.behavior: Fail closed or surface an actionable reconciliation defect. Authority remains with the existing Main Steward, semantic authority, human acceptance authority and Public Deployment Governance as applicable.

invariants: Canonical requirement ids remain retained inside the declared canonical range.
Completion-graph requirement references never escape canonical scope.
held_or_boundary exactly equals the retained LATER-01 requirement set.
A superseded requirement cannot remain silently active in the construction graph.
Every SUPERSEDED semantic decision retains a durable successor reference.
ACTIVE current_state and active_receipt retain the same node, increment and exact baseline lineage.
An incident-bound repair references current open incident truth and its durable repair contract.
Acceptance evidence keeps implementation, integration, reachability, verification, recovery, authority, consumer acceptance and value evidence distinct.
Discovery closure and work continuity retain unfinished ACTIVE, WAITING and BLOCKED work instead of allowing conversational disappearance.
A declared public-consequence handoff cannot be considered satisfied without a durable handoff reference.
SUPERSEDED_BY_EQUIVALENT requires semantic coverage evidence rather than an unproved already-covered label.
A newly added superseded requirement requires exact candidate evidence; historical supersession is never silently upgraded into equivalence.
